name: Katherine Eisold Miller
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New Rochelle, New York
side_practice_areas: Family Law, Alternative Dispute Resolution, Business & Corporate
about: A pillar of leadership within her legal community for nearly four decades, Katherine Eisold Miller has gone above and beyond the call of duty to help her clients lay to rest their contentious family law challenges by emphasizing an unwavering work ethic and meticulous focus in every case she takes on. The founder of the Miller Law Group in New Rochelle, New York, she serves residents throughout Westchester County in issues pertaining to divorce and separation, as well as estate planning and probate, and business law. In her family law practice, she utilizes alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation and collaboration in an effort to provide her clients with a seamless transition in their fresh starts.

Ms. Miller completed her undergraduate studies at Vassar College in Poughkeepsie, New York, graduating with her bachelor’s degree in political science. She went on to enroll at the Fordham University School of Law, where she honed her shrewd legal acumen and talents that remain evident in her practice today. She received her Juris Doctor in 1986, and in the very next year, she obtained her license to practice law in New York. She later became admitted to practice before the United States District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, as well as becoming licensed to practice law in Connecticut and admitted to practice before the United States District Court for the District of Connecticut.

A consummate professional through and through, Ms. Miller ensures that her clients are provided the support they need during this tumultuous time in their lives and the transparency through every stage of the legal process. For her many contributions, she has been AV Preeminent peer-review rated* through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest rating, and holds a perfect score of “10.0” on Avvo, as well as numerous positive client testimonials on the latter site as well.

Ms. Miller maintains close affiliations with numerous legal organizations of prominence, including the New York State Bar Association, the Connecticut Bar Association, the International Academy of Collaborative Professionals and the New York Association of Collaborative Professionals.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
